HGR_InitPreserveCondition_tt: If enabled, when weapon parts are initialized for the first time, all parts are set to match the weapon's current condition. This prevents the weapon from losing condition after its internal parts are created.
HGR_EnableDegradation_tt: Enables Hybrid Gun Repair's advanced per-part degradation system. If disabled, only the vanilla degradation behavior is used.
HGR_DegrChanceFactor_tt: Multiplier applied to the base degradation probability. Higher values increase how often weapon parts are damaged during use.
HGR_DegrChanceMin_tt: The minimum possible probability (in percent) that degradation may occur after calculation.
HGR_DegrChanceMax_tt: The maximum possible probability (in percent) that degradation may reach after calculation.
HGR_DegrBaseDrop_tt: Base amount of wear applied to internal parts when a degradation event occurs, before applying weighting and Maintenance skill modifiers.
HGR_MaintDropScale_tt: How much the Maintenance skill reduces total degradation. Larger values make Maintenance more protective against part wear.
HGR_SwingEveryN_tt: Determines how often degradation checks occur. Higher numbers reduce degradation frequency.
